people.name: the steward of The Reach

people.name: the jarl of The Reach
people.role: pays the bounty if the journal sends you to the jarl instead, at Understone Keep in Markarth

unsure.why: These records show nothing that hands you this The Reach bounty: no dialogue line, no letter and no start event point to it. The quest has slots for an innkeeper and a letter, which suggests an innkeeper's letter or the hold's steward offers it, but that can't be confirmed here. The game's own shared bounty quests are still the ones wired to start when you enter a hold.
Because no start is recorded for this copy, it may never be offered in a normal game; it may only run if something outside these files starts it.
The place to clear is picked when the bounty starts, so it changes from game to game. The hold is The Reach going by how the quest is set up; the exact place isn't in these files.

The steward and jarl are filled in when the quest starts. Understone Keep in Markarth is the hold's seat in the records, but who sits there can change during the war, and their daily schedules weren't checked.
The gold amount isn't in these files. The game's own shared version of this bounty also hands out an extra reward from Requiem; this hold copy lists only gold.
The journal can send you to either the steward or the jarl to collect; what decides which one isn't in these files.
